Also among all the participants we will do an steam controller and an steam link raffle.

Rules and more info please go to our web : [url=www.digitaltentacle.com] www.digitaltentacle.com	[/url]

We appreciate your support over this year and a half,
Best,
Digital Tentacle

Feel free to share the contest! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update-Workshop integration for the Circuits Composer
notes.notes:
We have made an update to our Circuits Composer,

now everyone can upload their own songs to the workshop and also their own sounds to being used into de composer. And also everyone can download the others sounds and songs to use it on the composer.

here we created a little guide to help you understanding how to use this new feature : 

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=496294079


Please if you have any question let us know. 

Now you can go to the workshop tab on the circuits community hub and suscribe to the items you want. They will automatically download and will be ready to use in the next composer launch.

Regards,
Digital Tentacle.

notes.title: Circuits Composer is here!
notes.notes:
Al last ( thank you for the patience :D ), the [b]Circuits Composer[/b] is here as a free update for all of out circuits players.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2-A00OZZarc]Launch trailer[/url]

[b]Circuits Composer[/b] is a tool that will let our players to experiment and build music in an easy way. Build upon the circuits fundation : listen . There´s no need to theory or musical technique knowledge to create a good sounding piece of music ( of course this comes with a counterpart ). But we want to create a well looking, easy to use tool to experiment with sounds. We hope you enjoy it. 

[b]How to launch Circuits composer[/b] : 

1/ launch circuits normally
2/ select circuits composer from the popup menu

[b]Roadmap for the composer[/b] : 

-Next composer update will feature steam workshop integration, and the option for people to put their own sounds into the composer, to share it, and also to share songs. 

-We will add in the next update also a volume automation for each track and block

[b]Song sharing policy[/b]  : Feel free to upload any song you make with the composer to soundcloud, youtube, or similar. We are more than happy to hear the music you do with the composer. The only thing we ask is to tell that is done with "circuits composer". If you want to use any of the slices in your music for professional use please send us an email to david.garcia@digitaltentacle.com

[b]Trello board[/b] : we have opened a trello board where people can share or discuss aspects about the game : [url=https://trello.com/b/94mlxKDn/circuits-composer] Trello board[/url]



[b]Known issues[/b] : 

-Composer launcher has a wrong image ( it says circuits editor not composer )
-Some sample descriptions are incomplete
-Shortcut drag timeline : alt + MMB is wrong. we will delete it in next update
-in some computers the game may feel sluggish. write us! isn´t working properly.

notes.title: Circuits Composer is coming, and for free for all of circuits players
notes.notes:
We are really close to finish our "Circuits Composer". An expansion for our Circuits core game. In the composer you can freely build music and share it through steam workshop, import others people music...all the fine details and some surprises coming later.

We cannot give yet an exact launch date. but "soon". And will be free for all of our steam players. After deploy the Composer the game will raise it´s price a little. We need to survive, you know :)

Also Circuits will have a little update with some quality of life improvements and little fixes and also thanks to the amazing community in steam, 3 more languajes.

here is a sneak peek of the composer : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AZlifcx-MK4

Thank you all,
Digital Tentacle.

notes.title: Chipzel, the awesome super hexagon composer will create a level Song
notes.notes:
Chipzel, best known for her musical score for the fantastic and super addictive game Super Hexagon, will be composing a song for a level in next updates of circuits.

If you don´t know how Chipzel sound is i recommend looking for her works on band camp or sound cloud. i personally love her spectra album. Deep, fresh , ad full of awesome musical ideas .

fantastic news :)

notes.title: update and Soundtrack for you all
notes.notes:
We have been updated the game. this update include the next fixes :

-Level 23 must have it´s layers sounding with their respective sounds
-Level 18 have been redesigned for a clear understanding
-Fixed a major bug that don´t let a few player under some situations play past level 6
-Fixed non localized text in fail level window.

We have been upload the full soundtrack and a bonus track for you all. You can find the soundtrack into the circuits directory in the OST folder.

Again, thank you all for the support.


( oh, we will be gifting an special track for you all )

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Circuits, 20% off!
notes.notes:
Circuits is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off!*

Piece together the different parts of a song. Sounds easy, but maybe not. Simple in concept, but very challenging and rewarding, Circuits is a musical puzzle game that requires careful listening to complete each level.

So if you like music, you will like Circuits .

*Offer ends April 24 at 10AM Pacific Time
